details:
On a humanoid avatar, when the VRC Avatar Descriptor has an empty `baseAnimationLayers` list but `customizeAnimationLayers` is false, then in `InitAnimLayer` a NullReferenceException is thrown from `element.FindPropertyRelative("type").enumValueIndex = (int)type;`

This is caused by `EnforceAnimLayerSetup` assuming there is at least one layer, and calling `InitAnimLayer` with index=1; `list.InsertArrayElementAtIndex(1)` then fails, and so the subsequent `GetArrayElementAtIndex` also returns null.

This issue was encountered by a user of Vroid's Xavatar, and reported to me as a potential Modular Avatar bug (MA invokes this code to normalize animator layers, but this also happens just by opening the inspector normally).
